# hackerone_asset (Resource)

Manages an asset in a HackerOne organization's asset inventory.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_type` (String) Asset type (e.g. `domain`, `url`, `cidr`, `github_repo`). Immutable after creation.
- `identifier` (String) The asset identifier (e.g. `example.com`). Immutable after creation.
- `organization_id` (String) Numeric ID of the organization that owns the asset.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description of the asset.
- `max_severity` (String) Maximum severity for findings on this asset (`none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`).
- `reference` (String) An internal reference identifier for the asset.

### Read-Only

- `asset_id` (String) The bare numeric asset ID (without the organization prefix). Reference this from `hackerone_asset_scope.asset_id`.
- `id` (String) Composite ID in the form `organization_id/asset_id`.
